g.text: Cloud session to main: how the work gets back to your PC
Route A: merge on GitHub's website (recommended)
Route B: ask Claude on your PC to merge it (no review page)
A1 · you create a PR (in claude.ai/code)
A2 · review the Files changed tab

text.tspan: Not happy? Close the PR unmerged.
Conflict = both sides changed the same lines.
git pull in A4 or git merge in B1 stops:
